target: acceptance 4 — the pre-consolidation file is preserved as a timestamped copy alongside. 'Committed first' is not acceptable: the sandbox has no git, so no case could ever verify it.
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/learnings/exact_dupes.md" t.md; before=$(cksum < t.md); "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/learnings.sh" consolidate t.md >/dev/null 2>&1; bak=$(ls t.md.* 2>/dev/null | head -1); restored=$([ -n "$bak" ] && cksum < "$bak" || echo none); [ "$before" = "$restored" ] && ok=1 || ok=0; gitless=$([ -d .git ] && echo 1 || echo 0); printf '{"backupMatchesOriginal":%s,"noGitNeeded":%s}' "$ok" "$((1-gitless))"
